basic_info.description: Luxury in the heart of Nob Hill! A beautifully updated, spacious 3+ Bed /2 Bath condo with private outdoor space. This well maintained single-family alternative checks all the boxes while blending San Francisco charm with modern amenities for comfortable city living. The open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area create a seamless flow for entertaining. The chef's kitchen is equipped with high-end stainless steel appliances, pantry, generous counter space, and custom cabinetry. On the main floor, two bedrooms and an office share the tiled full bath with shower-over-tub. Below, at the rear of the home, a luxurious primary bedroom suite includes two walk-in closets and spacious bath, replete with dual sink vanity and walk-in shower. Both levels offer direct access to your exclusive rear yard, a private retreat perfect for that morning coffee, al fresco dining, entertaining, and relaxation. Thoughtfully landscaped with a timed irrigation system and mature plantings. Dual-pane windows enhance efficiency and tranquility. Ideally situated along the cable car line and nearby grocery stores, cafes, and restaurants. Parking and storage space included.
